data.name: Apps.Reason.Promo
data.value: Preinstalled for advertising. Uninstalling it breaks nothing.

data.name: Apps.Reason.Unused
data.value: Preinstalled app that most people never use. It can be reinstalled from the Microsoft Store.

data.name: Apps.Reason.Oem
data.value: Tool added by the PC manufacturer. Keep it if you use its features (updates, warranty, security).

data.name: Apps.Reason.Keep
data.value: Needed by Windows or by other programs: keep it.

data.name: Apps.Explanation.Silent
data.value: Uninstalled without any window. A restore point is created first.

data.name: Apps.Explanation.Interactive
data.value: This program has no silent mode: its own uninstaller window will open, follow its steps.

data.name: Apps.Explanation.Provisioned
data.value: Also removed from Windows so that it does not come back for new accounts.

data.name: Apps.Explanation.Leftover
data.value: Folder left by an uninstalled program. It is moved to quarantine (restorable from History) and deleted after 7 days.

data.name: Apps.Intro
data.value: Uninstall programs cleanly, remove preinstalled apps, and put leftover folders in quarantine.

data.name: Apps.PreinstalledIntro
data.value: Apps added by Microsoft or the PC manufacturer. The safe ones are already ticked.

data.name: Apps.NotSupported
data.value: Installed for your account only: uninstall it from Windows Settings.
